<noinclude>This page lists all uncommon set items, excluding the major class-focused sets. Also see: [[All Set Items]]

== Uncommon Sets ==
Set bonuses are listed separately rather than cumulatively - if multiple bonuses add the same attributes, those bonuses will be added together before taking effect.

<span class="nmod">Set items may be ethereal. They may also be [[Recipes#Upgrading_Recipes|upgraded]].</span>

In addition to the changes listed here, all melee weapons also gain <span class="nmod">Melee Attacks Deal Splash Damage</span>.
</noinclude>
=== Cow King's Leathers ===
'''Notes:''' 

This set can only be collected in the Secret Cow Level. Despite the name, it drops from any monster in the Secret Cow Level, not just the Cow King.

Hell Bovine monsters found elsewhere, such as the [[Maps#Blood_Moon|Blood Moon]] map, will not drop items from this set.
